title: Mean of a bounded Boolean function
statement: For $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $0\le f(x)\le1$ for every $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Then its uniform expectation satisfies $0\le\E[f]\le1$.
replaced: If $f:\{0,1\}^n\to[0,1]$, then its uniform mean satisfies $\mathbb E f\in[0,1]$.
